objective: Test whether Cboe-derived incremental future-variance information can make an already-frozen nominal-beta composition rule more stable against SOXX by applying it only when the Cboe candidate predicts more variance than its matched price-only baseline.
distinct_mechanism: Condition the existing fixed funded asset-composition cancellation on an independent lagged option-activity variance signal. Do not change the parent controller risk projection, beta-preserving algebra, forecast models, action classifier, or account accounting.

parent.historical_result: Three 0/2/5bp net accounts exceeded SOXX in terminal wealth, but 0bp maximum drawdown exceeded 30%, all rolling 126-session win rates were below 70%, and SOXX block lower bounds were not positive; fixed version not promoted.

information_dependency.required_status: information_gate_pass=true from one completed native Qlib Recorder after the third frozen Cboe source vintage

clock: For opening account date d, use only the Cboe variance forecasts generated at 09:46 New York on the immediately preceding Qlib session s. They use Cboe total activity and prices no later than s-1, so an action at d open has no same-day 09:46 lookahead. Apply the same prior-session decision to any recovery target on d. At the initial 2023-01-03 account date, use identity until the first eligible prior-session forecast; after warmup, any missing forecast stops the experiment.
fixed_trigger: High incremental Cboe variance information iff candidate predicted log next-five-session SOXX realized variance > baseline predicted log variance on the same prior signal s. Equality uses identity. No percentile, learned threshold or regime search.

target_map.when_trigger_false: identity; preserve the parent post-projection SOXL/SOXX/CASH target
target_map.when_trigger_true: delta=min(SOXL,CASH/2); replace target (SOXL,SOXX,CASH) by (SOXL-delta,SOXX+3*delta,CASH-2*delta), exactly the parent funded nominal-beta mapping
target_map.HOLD: never transform or force a trade
invariants: weights finite, nonnegative and sum to one
new SOXL weight not above parent target
candidate own holdings, cash, fees, risk state and recovery history recur independently

account_contract.fees: exact frozen IBKR Pro Tiered projection and dividend/cash/settlement treatment from parent plan; require source hashes and native Qlib account identities before run
account_contract.controls: Reuse exact verified parent strong_always, always-composition and SOXX accounts only when source provider, price plane, date span, costs and accounting identities match; otherwise stop before candidate replay rather than choose controls after outcome.

scientific_gates.hard_benchmark: SOXX fee-net same-window same-accounting, all 0/2/5bp wealth ratios >1
scientific_gates.max_drawdown: closing and available intraday <=30%; missing full minute risk evidence is an explicit qualification gap
scientific_gates.complete_years: at least two and >=70% positive complete-year excess

SOXX_block_bootstrap.note: one additional economic candidate conservatively counted beyond the base v2 family of 15; all reused historical search remains development-only

scientific_gates.independent_forward: identity-fixed source-qualified prospective economic and statistical evidence, including year/window length and market-state coverage; zero qualified days at design time

stops: Cboe source third vintage or fixed information gate fails: close design without economic accounts.
Price plane, parent account, source clock, predecessor-session alignment or control identities mismatch: stop before account; do not substitute a convenient provider.
No trigger inversion, threshold, cash fraction, cost, year, window or bootstrap tuning after results.
Even historical economic passes are not promotion without independently timed forward source and economic account evidence.
artifacts: Only a later executable notebook, slim card sidecars and native Qlib Recorder may hold model/portfolio evidence; this design brief has zero model fits and zero accounts.
next_action: After the frozen Cboe information result, if all dependency gates pass, bind exact source/model/parent identities, create the executable notebook and run the three candidate native accounts once. If the information gate fails, mark this contingent design not_executed_due_dependency and keep the overall Goal active.
